# ========================================================================
# NAME ITEMS. One file, per the 2026-08-30 rule -- there is no
# longer a second batch to remember to run. They follow the Geni ids
# above, per the 2026-09-04 correction.
# ========================================================================
# Name items the Garborg batches need, AND the statements that use them.
#
# Each CREATE is followed by `Qperson  Pprop  LAST` for every bearer who
# ALREADY holds a QID -- LAST is exactly how you point at what was just
# created. A person this run is also CREATING cannot be linked here, because
# LAST would then name the person; they wait for the next run.
#
# A patronymic is its own item even where the spelling exists as a given
# name: CLAUDE.md, one name item per USAGE. Q141152710 Aadnesson is
# the pattern -- labels and P31.
#
# A created PATRONYMIC also carries P144 based on: the given names it derives
# from, one value for every such name the fathers who bear it actually carry.
# That is what the resolution algorithm reads -- a person gets P5056 when their
# father's P735 item is among these values -- so an item minted without them
# can never resolve anybody. reports/patronymic-items-to-create.tsv resolves
# them, and leaves out any given name whose label is ambiguous or has no item.

# Fintland -- family, 4 bearer(s) in the batches
# create a new item
CREATE
#   the item just created: set the en label to "Fintland"
LAST	Len	"Fintland"
#   set the mul label to "Fintland"
LAST	Lmul	"Fintland"
#   set the ja label to "フィントランド"
LAST	Lja	"フィントランド"
#   set the zh label to "芬特兰德"
LAST	Lzh	"芬特兰德"
#   set the ko label to "핀트란드"
LAST	Lko	"핀트란드"
#   set the en description to "family name"
LAST	Den	"family name"
#   P31 instance of = Q101352
LAST	P31	Q101352
#   P1705 native label = mul:"Fintland"
LAST	P1705	mul:"Fintland"
#   P282 writing system = Q8229 Latin script
LAST	P282	Q8229
#   Q141565559 Johannes Larsen Fintland: P734 family name = the item just created
Q141565559	P734	LAST	S2600	"6000000005018842387"
#   Q141565162 Gunhild Karlsdatter Fintland: P734 family name = the item just created, qualified P3831 object of statement has role Q28418670 married name
Q141565162	P734	LAST	P3831	Q28418670	S2600	"6000000005018904531"

Q141562976	P734	LAST	P3831	Q2507958	S2600	"6000000006787547225"

# ======================================================================
# DESCRIPTIONS on name items that already exist and have none.
# Label + description must be unique per language, so this is what
# makes Wikidata refuse a duplicate of a name item already in use.
# Name items only -- never people.
# ======================================================================
#   Q106145212: set the en description to "given name"

# ======================================================================
# P144 BASED ON, on patronymic items that already exist and lack it.
# The given names each patronymic derives from, which is what the
# resolution rule reads: a bearer gets P5056 when their father's
# P735 item is among these values. Patronymics only -- never people.
# ======================================================================
#   Q141552246: P144 based on = Q127069 Ivar
Q141552246	P144	Q127069
#   P144 based on = Q11977747 Iver
Q141552246	P144	Q11977747

# ======================================================================
# P460 SAID TO BE THE SAME AS, between spellings of one patronymic.
# Both ways, as written by hand on Olofsson and Olai. Only
# where the two items share a P144 source, a stem and a gendered
# suffix -- a shared source alone matches Jonsdatter to Johansdotter.
# ======================================================================
#   Q141421834: P460 said to be the same as = Q141564539
Q141421834	P460	Q141564539
